name: jpai-delivery
description: Delivery workflow from jpeak.ai: PR review feedback filtering and category-level prevention (snr-pr), single-question decision consolidation that self-answers from existing decision records before asking (concise-decisions), and ticketing that follows a repo's own TICKETING.md for tickets, work in progress and cleanup (tickety-boo).

interface.shortDescription: Review feedback filtering, decision consolidation and TICKETING.md-driven ticketing
interface.longDescription: The delivery half of the jpeak.ai skill set. snr-pr filters existing code review results into Signal and Noise, improves review filters for Noise, and prevents recurring problem categories for Signal. concise-decisions self-answers from existing decision records, then puts the single highest-leverage remaining question with a full briefing and captures the user's reasoning as a reusable lens. tickety-boo follows a repo's own TICKETING.md to create and deduplicate tickets, report the current user's work in progress, and plan cleanup of finished work. All skills are mirrored from the canonical skills/ tree by scripts/sync_plugins.py, so a pack can never drift from the copy it was built from.
